function: F_q(s) = c L(s, chi) + conj(c) L(s, chi-bar), c = (1 - i k)/2, chi of order 4 mod q with chi(g) = i at the least primitive root g; G_q(s) = (q/pi)^(s/2) Gamma(s/2) F_q(s) = G_q(1 - s); a zero means a zero of G_q

grades.route_A: measured: mpmath fp evaluation, folded argument principle, right-box winding counts, Newton to |F| < 1e-11
grades.route_B: enclosure-carrying given the classical functional equation, the Gauss-sum root number and the cited Rademacher bound: Arb balls, winding.py's chord-tube rule, decided sign changes and decided boxes
grades.pari: measured: every off-line zero re-located by PARI's own Newton iteration on its own Hurwitz zeta; the lowest per q also on lfun of F's own series and on the two-character combination
grades.abscissa: enclosure-carrying (Arb), strip2.py's Euler-phase method ported to q

accounting: per window n_box = n_line + 2 n_right; n_box from the folded count N(0, T) = Psi(T)/pi at the window ends, n_line from sign changes of Z on the route's own grid plus its own signs at the ends, n_right from right-box counts (route A) or decided unit boxes (route B)

17.statement: every zero of G_17 (every nontrivial zero of F_17) has 1 - 1.09896904163 < Re s < 1.09896904163

73.statement: every zero of G_73 (every nontrivial zero of F_73) has 1 - 1.0445906373 < Re s < 1.0445906373
